concept: 仙女喜歡下凡做美食；初遇全部呈現靈獸，只有 SSR／UR 可覺醒為仙女，其餘永遠保持靈獸。 雲上宴席的光與香逐漸消散；她們發現只收藏珍貴材料留不住滋味，必須真正陪伴、烹調並分享。

productionBaseline.unpublishedChanges: Main differs from released source only by the V3.9.2 release receipt commits 6205acb and 7b7fb0b. Other worktree features including V3.9.7 are excluded.
productionBaseline.verificationScope: Fetched main and gh-pages; live release-artifact.json SHA-256 and artifact identity match deployment receipt/Git descriptor; live version bytes match manifest. This is baseline verification, not whole-package acceptance or new pool release verification.

animationPlan.reason: Morning/evening food-sharing story differs from Honeylight's candy garden; retain common timing with new cloud-kitchen visual composition.
animationPlan.storyboard: Cloud stair appears, dawn and dusk food baskets approach the central pavilion, two fragrance trails meet at the feast bowl; official pool name followed by two lines and continue prompt.
animationPlan.rarityNotes: SSR 2500ms／UR 4500ms，以花露、守灶、櫻花、香霧形成各自辨識點；初遇始終靈獸。
animationPlan.motionNotes: 共用3400ms入場、3000ms前奏、等待繼續、略過與Escape；減少動態500ms。場景共用SVG座標；不改交易。
